construction.note: Local shared-framework origins are verified for SDK SHA-256 8c9ab2e845e7ca16d6a185d47d2131fd43f3f147827c0fa56ae5552a9e52490e in reports/construction/origin-evidence.json using actual installer DownloadFile events, local blob-feed archive hashes and final SDK byte comparisons.
